name: Development
description: Test workspace commands: passing and failing checks, a long-running server, interactive terminal programs, and a counter.

actions.title: Check
actions.description: Run a quick check that succeeds.

actions.title: Failing check
actions.description: Run a check that exits with status 3.

actions.title: Web server
actions.description: Start a long-running development server that logs a heartbeat.

actions.title: Templated arguments
actions.description: Print the arguments built from the input with argv placeholders; no shell or wrapper.

actions.title: Interactive prompt
actions.description: Ask for a name in a real terminal.

actions.title: Count
actions.description: Increment a counter file in the plugin state directory; shows request-key deduplication.

actions.title: Log flood
actions.description: Print many log lines quickly to exercise bounded logs.

actions.title: Greeter
actions.description: A long-running process whose greeting comes from its input.

actions.title: Stubborn process
actions.description: Ignores SIGTERM so the stop sequence must escalate to SIGKILL.

actions.title: Cleanup fails
actions.description: Succeeds, but its cleanup command exits with status 4.

argv: import os,sys; print('cleanup reason', os.environ['MIRA_STOP_REASON']); sys.exit(4)

actions.title: Environment check
actions.description: Prints which environment layers reached the child, without printing secret values.

actions.title: Heartbeat
actions.description: Every 2 seconds, count TODO markers in README.md and record the result; no model or network.

actions.title: Interactive prompt (Ctrl-C stop)
actions.description: The same prompt; stopping it sends Ctrl-C through the terminal first.

actions.title: Full-screen program
actions.description: A small curses program on the alternate screen; press q to quit.

actions.title: Editor
actions.description: Open a scratch file in vi without user configuration; type :q! and Enter to quit.

actions.title: Hostile terminal output
actions.description: Print clipboard, title, and window sequences split across writes, then plain text.

actions.title: Bracketed paste probe
actions.description: Enable bracketed paste, then report exactly what one paste delivered.

actions.title: Stubborn terminal program
actions.description: Ignores Ctrl-C and SIGTERM in a terminal, so the stop sequence must escalate to SIGKILL.
